class.name: SpineSlotPose
class.brief_description: Stores a pose for a slot.
class.description: Stores the current pose for a slot, including color tinting, attachment, and deformation values.

method.name: get_color
method.description: Returns the color used to tint the slot's attachment. If dark color is set, this is used as the light color for two color tinting.

method.name: set_color
method.description: Sets the color used to tint the slot's attachment. If dark color is set, this is used as the light color for two color tinting.

method.name: get_dark_color
method.description: Returns the dark color used to tint the slot's attachment for two color tinting. The dark color's alpha is not used.

method.name: set_dark_color
method.description: Sets the dark color used to tint the slot's attachment for two color tinting. The dark color's alpha is not used.

method.name: has_dark_color
method.description: Returns true if this slot has a dark color.

method.name: set_has_dark_color
method.description: Sets whether this slot has a dark color.

method.name: get_attachment
method.description: Returns the current attachment for the slot, or null if the slot has no attachment.

method.name: set_attachment
method.description: Sets the slot's attachment and, if the attachment changed, resets sequence_index and clears the deform. The deform is not cleared if the old attachment has the same timeline attachment as the specified attachment.

method.name: get_sequence_index
method.description: Returns the index of the texture region to display when the slot's attachment has a Sequence. -1 represents the setup index.

method.name: set_sequence_index
method.description: Sets the index of the texture region to display when the slot's attachment has a Sequence. -1 represents the setup index.

method.name: get_deform
method.description: Returns values to deform the slot's attachment. For an unweighted mesh, the entries are local positions for each vertex. For a weighted mesh, the entries are an offset for each vertex which will be added to the mesh's local vertex positions.

method.name: set_deform
method.description: Sets values to deform the slot's attachment. For an unweighted mesh, the entries are local positions for each vertex. For a weighted mesh, the entries are an offset for each vertex which will be added to the mesh's local vertex positions.

members.member: The color used to tint the slot's attachment. When [member has_dark_color] is true, this is the light color for two-color tinting.
The dark color used for two-color tinting. Its alpha component is not used.
Whether the slot uses [member dark_color] for two-color tinting.

The slot's current attachment, or [code]null[/code] if none is set. Changing it resets [member sequence_index] and usually clears [member deform]; the deform is preserved when the old and new attachments share the same timeline attachment. A new wrapper may be returned on each access.
The texture region index displayed by an attachment with a sequence. [code]-1[/code] selects the sequence's setup index.

A copied array of values that deform the slot's attachment. For an unweighted mesh, entries are local vertex positions; for a weighted mesh, entries are offsets added to the mesh's local vertex positions. Each read returns a copy, so modifying that array does not change the native pose until the changed array is assigned back through this property.
